summary: Prepare isolated sample identities and collect source-bound catalog contracts for G0/G1; leave product adoption and restore/soak evidence open.
businessInvariants: No account creation/reset, role change, global logout or business writes; only inventoried sample principal logins and own-profile reads.
POS and Office retain separate Auth/DB and explicit sample store identity; do not infer legal-entity ownership.
Catalog evidence is hashes/metadata only, not fresh/upgrade/whole-plan completion; original operational login waiver remains NOT_RUN.

nPlusOne.reason: Nine independent Auth principals require independent authentication; catalog is one set-based statement/project, no business item requests.
nPlusOne.scale: 9 principals, 2 projects, concurrency one for Auth; 20,000 metadata objects and 6MiB/project maximum.
nPlusOne.verification: resilience-tools-unit, runtime-catalog-unit, runtime-catalog-postgres; live sanitized metadata/login evidence separately, never inferred from these tests.

setBasedSql.reason: Catalog columns pre-aggregate by relation; catalog object metadata uses set unions, never loops over business rows.
setBasedSql.scale: 2 catalog statements plus bounded own-profile reads.
setBasedSql.verification: resilience-tools-unit, runtime-catalog-unit, runtime-catalog-postgres; live sanitized metadata/login evidence separately, never inferred from these tests.

rowsColumns.reason: Only explicit own-profile columns with limit 2; catalog metadata projects hashes, no function bodies or business rows.
rowsColumns.scale: At most 2 profile rows per principal; 128KiB/Auth HTTP; 6MiB/catalog.
rowsColumns.verification: resilience-tools-unit, runtime-catalog-unit, runtime-catalog-postgres; live sanitized metadata/login evidence separately, never inferred from these tests.

joinCardinality.reason: Catalog columns aggregate separately before relation join; other arms have one row per named object.
joinCardinality.scale: No business one-to-many joins; duplicate object identities rejected.
joinCardinality.verification: resilience-tools-unit, runtime-catalog-unit, runtime-catalog-postgres; live sanitized metadata/login evidence separately, never inferred from these tests.

indexesPaging.reason: Own profile uses auth_id equality and limit 2; catalog snapshot is bounded metadata and avoids OFFSET.
indexesPaging.scale: 9 fixed principals, finite catalogs; no schema/index mutations.
indexesPaging.verification: resilience-tools-unit, runtime-catalog-unit, runtime-catalog-postgres; live sanitized metadata/login evidence separately, never inferred from these tests.

refreshPolling.reason: Explicit one-shot checks only; no polling or state invalidations added.
refreshPolling.scale: One run per evidence capture, 3 calls/principal maximum.
refreshPolling.verification: resilience-tools-unit, runtime-catalog-unit, runtime-catalog-postgres; live sanitized metadata/login evidence separately, never inferred from these tests.

cacheScope.reason: No persistent session or profile cache; artifacts identify project/source and each verified principal.
cacheScope.scale: Separate target keys/identities; cross-project comparison rejected.
cacheScope.verification: resilience-tools-unit, runtime-catalog-unit, runtime-catalog-postgres; live sanitized metadata/login evidence separately, never inferred from these tests.

concurrency.reason: Auth concurrency one, no retries; read-only two-project catalog captures can run concurrently.
concurrency.scale: 9 sample principals, max 2 concurrent catalog calls.
concurrency.verification: resilience-tools-unit, runtime-catalog-unit, runtime-catalog-postgres; live sanitized metadata/login evidence separately, never inferred from these tests.

retryIdempotency.reason: Never retry password login or unknown cleanup; always attempt only local logout after successful login.
retryIdempotency.scale: 1 login attempt, at most 3 HTTP calls/principal, 12-second request timeout.
retryIdempotency.verification: resilience-tools-unit, runtime-catalog-unit, runtime-catalog-postgres; live sanitized metadata/login evidence separately, never inferred from these tests.

largeResults.reason: Auth and catalog payloads have explicit bounds; oversize or partial results fail, not silently truncate.
largeResults.scale: 128KiB per Auth response, <=20,000 objects and <=6MiB catalog; <=7MiB recorder input.
largeResults.verification: resilience-tools-unit, runtime-catalog-unit, runtime-catalog-postgres; live sanitized metadata/login evidence separately, never inferred from these tests.

repeatedAggregates.reason: Catalog aggregates only on explicit snapshot; no sales totals, counts per refresh or production polling.
repeatedAggregates.scale: One catalog snapshot per DB; no product screen changes.
repeatedAggregates.verification: resilience-tools-unit, runtime-catalog-unit, runtime-catalog-postgres; live sanitized metadata/login evidence separately, never inferred from these tests.

rollback: Revert the evidence tooling normally; do not delete runtime history, business data or other sessions. Private credentials remain outside Git and may be removed only when their assigned test lifecycle ends.

outcomes.reason: Login identity and local session cleanup are separate outcomes; unknown cleanup fails and stops further logins.

tenantScope.reason: Whitelist inventoried sample actor/profile/store IDs and separate POS/Office targets; reject broader Office scope.

readiness.reason: Account identity readiness is separate from permission actions, external-effect sandboxing, physical devices and 12-hour soaks.

dbCompatibility.reason: Catalog hashes current effective functions, triggers, RLS/ACL/indexes and history without changing production schema.

officeBoundary.reason: Office Auth and profile are verified independently; explicit store mapping is checked, no name or UUID ownership inference.

externalEffects.reason: No financial/notification/printing writes; session creation and current-session local cleanup are the only Auth effects.

resourceLifetime.reason: Token stays in memory only; local logout finally and stop on uncertain cleanup; no persisted refresh token.

filesAndHardware.reason: Private external owned mode-600 files, no shell eval, bounded responses; real hardware and long load remain NOT_RUN.
